author: Brenton Kemp
title: Blake Hunt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Padres have recalled catcher Blake Hunt from Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Hunt was recalled to take the active roster spot of fellow backstop Freddy Fermin, who was placed on the seven-day concussion injured list on Sunday. Hunt has hit .269 with one homer in eight games at Triple-A due to injury, and will make his MLB debut once he appears in a game for the Padres.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Freddy Fermin (concussion) placed on 7-day IL
desc: The Padres have placed catcher Freddy Fermin on the seven-day concussion injured list.
impact: Fermin sustained a head injury when he was hit by a warm-up pitch in the bottom of the sixth inning and will need some time off to heal. The backstop has been struggling at the plate, hitting just .148 with three homers in 51 appearances on the campaign.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tigers/Guardians postponed Sunday
desc: Sunday's contest between the Detroit Tigers and Cleveland Guardians has been postponed due to inclement weather according to Jason Beck.
impact: The originally scheduled contest between the two clubs will be made up as part of a split doubleheader September 4.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) has MRI come back clean
desc: Royals left-hander Kris Bubic (elbow) had an MRI come back negative after struggling in a rehab outing on Tuesday.
impact: After allowing five earned runs in just 1 1/3 innings for Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday, the Royals sent Bubic for a doctor's visit and subsequent MRI, which came back clean and with no structural damage. Bubic is expected to play catch on Sunday and continue his progression as symptoms allow.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) undergoes surgery, out 4-6 weeks
desc: Royals first baseman Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) underwent surgery to repair a left hamate fracture and is expected to miss four to six weeks.
impact: Pasquantino suffered the injury on a pop-up to third base during Saturday's loss to the Astros. Pasquantino was already enduring a disappointing season with a .224 average with just six homers and a .659 OPS through 68 games, and working his way back from hand surgery could prove to be difficult in an effort to get his season turned around.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Joey Estes optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics have optioned right-hander Joey Estes to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: In his first start of the season for the A's, Estes yielded four earned runs on five hits, including a homer, and a walk in 4 1/3 innings of work against the Rockies on Saturday. He was likely heading back to Las Vegas regardless, but it wasn't an encouraging outing for the 24-year-old. Left-hander Brady Basso was recalled from Vegas in a corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Brady Basso recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics have recalled left-hander Brady Basso from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Basso has made just three appearances for the A's this season, allowing two earned runs in 2 2/3 innings of work. Right-hander Joey Estes was sent to Vegas in a corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Austin Wells (headaches) to begin rehab assignment this week
desc: Yankees catcher Austin Wells (cervical headaches) will begin a rehab assignment this week, according to Aaron Boone.
impact: Wells was placed on the 10-day injured list on June 6 due to cervical headaches. He had an MRI on his neck on June 8 come back negative, and he began baseball activities on June 12. It's unclear how many rehab appearances Wells will require before re-joining the big club.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Justin Verlander (hip) to throw sim game Monday
desc: Tigers right-hander Justin Verlander (hip) is scheduled to throw a simulated game on Monday in Houston.
impact: Verlander's sim game on Monday will ensure he stays on a five-day schedule following his rehab start with Triple-A Toledo last Wednesday. It's unclear if Verlander's next start will remain at Triple-A after he allowed four solo homers in his outing there on Wednesday.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Spencer Strider (elbow) to visit Dr. Keith Meister this week
desc: Braves right-hander Spencer Strider (elbow) will visit elbow specialist Dr. Keith Meister this week.
impact: Braves skipper Walt Weiss said there is "nothing definitive yet" on Strider's elbow, and that the next step is to visit Dr. Meister. Right now, Strider's injury is being described as inflammation, but a notable decrease in velocity is a major concern. We will wait and see what Strider's visit reveals in the coming days.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Tristan Beck recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Giants have recalled right-hander Tristan Beck from Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Beck was optioned to Sacramento on Wednesday, but will return to take the active roster spot of Keaton Winn (elbow), who was placed on the injured list on Sunday. Beck owns a 9.00 ERA in six outings with the Giants this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Keaton Winn (elbow) placed on injured list
desc: The Giants have placed right-hander Keaton Winn on the injured list due to a right elbow strain.
impact: Winn blew a save and allowed three earned runs in just 2/3 of an inning his last time out on Tuesday, and will hit the injured list nearly a week later. The 28-year-old has been solid in posting a 3.23 ERA out of the Giants' bullpen in 30 2/3 innings this season. His timeline should be updated in the coming days.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (back) out of starting lineup again Sunday
desc: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (back) is not in the starting lineup Sunday against the Yankees.
impact: Guerrero sat out Saturday's contest and will remain out of the lineup on Sunday due to lower back tightness. With the Blue Jays off on Monday, the hope is that Guerrero will be able to return on Tuesday against the Red Sox.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Miguel Rojas (shin) available Sunday
desc: Dodgers infielder Miguel Rojas (shin) said he will be available for Sunday's series finale against the White Sox.
impact: Rojas said he has been dealing with a shin issue for a few days, and felt something come out of the batter's box on Saturday. Rather than stay in the game with starter Yoshinobu Yamamoto in the midst of a perfect game, Rojas didn't want to risk making a defensive error and decided to come out of the game. He said he is available to play on Sunday, as he is not in the starting lineup but could appear off the bench later in the contest.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Angel Martinez (foot) could be available off bench Sunday
desc: According to Guardians skipper Stephen Vogt, there is a "slight chance" that outfielder Angel Martinez (foot) could be available off the bench for Sunday's series finale against the Tigers.
impact: Martinez fouled the first pitch he saw from Tarik Skubal off his left foot on Saturday, and while he initially stayed in the game, he eventually departed the contest in the third inning. It sounds like the Guardians will do their best not to use Martinez on Sunday, given the team has an off-day on Monday. The hope is that Martinez will be good to go for Tuesday's series opener in Milwaukee.
